name: Opening Note
format_notes: Personal, conversational opener from the editor. Sets the week's theme. First person.

name: Top Story
format_notes: The single most important signal of the week. Lead with the insight, not the news. Include a bold pull quote.

name: Funding Radar
format_notes: 3-5 notable funding rounds or M&A moves. Bullet list format. One sentence per item explaining why it matters.

name: Trend Watch
format_notes: Emerging pattern across 2-3 signals. Connect dots the reader might have missed. Opinionated.

name: Founder Spotlight
format_notes: One founder story, lesson, or quote. Can be drawn from news or community. Inspirational but grounded.

name: Tool of the Week
format_notes: One product/tool relevant to founders. What it does, who it's for, why now. Non-promotional tone.

name: Numbers That Matter
format_notes: 3-5 stats or data points. Each on its own line: bold the number, plain text the context.

name: Closing Thought
format_notes: One-paragraph closing. Leave the reader with a question or provocation. Sign off with editor name.
